'''Ice-sailing''' was a winter sport enjoyed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. The majority of ice-sailing was undertaken on the [[Beija Major Sea]], and specialist [[ice-sailing craft]] could be rented from [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
